relationships.subject: SCFAs
relationships.evidence_quote: SCFA supplementation improved histone acetylation and abnormal synaptic transmission in the medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC), hippocampal CA1, and central amygdala (CeA) area via the ACSS2 (acetyl-CoA synthetase2)-HDAC2 (histone deacetylase 2) axis

relationships.subject: SCFAs
relationships.evidence_quote: SCFA administration considerably decreased the occurrence of cognitive impairment in the CPSP rats

relationships.subject: Gut microbiota
relationships.evidence_quote: the fecal microbiota transplantation from cognitively compromised pain rats can induce the hallmarks of cognitive deficit behavior to germ-free recipient rats

relationships.subject: Butyrate
relationships.evidence_quote: Butyrate, an HDAC inhibitor, inhibits histone deacetylase activity to increase histone acetylation.

relationships.subject: SCFAs
relationships.evidence_quote: SCFAs, main butyrate, have been shown to strengthen the integrity of the epithelial barrier and the blood–brain barrier

key_findings: About two-thirds of CPSP rats had cognitive impairment with reduced SCFA-producing gut bacteria; FMT transferred the deficit.
Acetate/butyrate supplementation restored ACSS2/HDAC2, histone acetylation and mEPSC deficits in mPFC, CA1 and CeA.
